empty.title: Welcome to TrekList 👋
empty.intro: TrekList helps you plan and pack your hiking gear so you don't forget anything on your next trip.
empty.gettingStartedBody: Start by creating your first gear list in the Gear Lists panel on the left. Type a trip or pack name in the New list box and click the + button. That opens your first list, where you can add categories like Rifugios, Hiking, or Toiletries. Then use the My Gear panel to build your personal gear library—adding items you own or want to buy—and add those items into the right categories in your list.
empty.howOrganizedGearLists: One list per trip or pack, for example Alta Via 1, Tour du Mont Blanc, or Ultralight Summer 2025.
empty.howOrganizedMyGear: Your library of gear you currently own or want to buy. You can reuse these items across different lists.
empty.howOrganizedPackStats: At the top of each list you'll see total, base, worn, and consumable weight, so you can dial in your pack.
empty.settingsListMenu: Use the … (ellipsis) menu at the top of a gear list for list-specific preferences like background, checklist view, share, copy, and delete.
empty.settingsAccount: Use the icon in the top-right of the app for account and global settings.
empty.startFromScratch: Or start from scratch in the Gear Lists panel.
